final_announce: Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 4]; rule=the device turns on if object 0 and object 4 are present and no more than five objects are placed on the device.

Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 2, object 4, object 5]; rule=The device turns on if object 4 or object 5 is placed on it alone or with any object except object 3, but not if both object 4 and object 5 are placed together.

Announce: relevant=[object 1, object 4, object 7]; rule=The device turns on when any one of object 1, object 4, or object 7 is included alone, but turns off if any two or more of these are included together or if none are included. Other objects have no effect.

Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 2, object 3]; rule=The device turns on if object 2 is placed alone, if at least two of object 0, object 1, and object 2 are placed together, or if object 3 is placed alone or with any other object, but only if the total number of objects is 4 or fewer.

Announce: relevant=[object 3, object 4, object 5, object 6, object 7]; rule=The device turns on when object 4 or 5 is placed alone, or when object 3 is placed with object 6 or 7. It does not turn on when object 6 or 7 is placed alone, or when object 3 is placed with object 4 or 5.
Announce: relevant=[object 6]; rule=the device turns on if object 6 is present, regardless of other objects.
Announce: relevant=[object 4]; rule=The device turns on if object 4 is placed on it, but only when neither object 5 nor object 7 is present.
Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 4, object 6]; rule=The device turns on if object 0 is placed on it, but turns off if object 4 or object 6 is also included.

Announce: relevant=[object 1, object 2, object 3, object 4]; rule=The device turns on when object 1 is placed with any other object, or when object 3 or object 4 is placed alone. It turns off when object 1 is alone, when object 2 is alone, when only non-relevant objects are placed, or when object 3 and object 4 are placed together.
Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 2]; rule=The device turns on if objects 0, 1, and 2 are placed together, regardless of other objects.
Announce: relevant=[object 1, object 6, object 7]; rule=The device turns on if object 1 is placed on it, but only if neither object 6 nor object 7 is also placed on it.
Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 6]; rule=The device turns on if object 0 is placed, but only if object 6 is not included.

Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 2, object 3, object 4, object 5, object 6, object 7]; rule=The device turns on if an odd number of objects from the full set {object 0, object 1, object 2, object 3, object 4, object 5, object 6, object 7} are placed.
Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 4]; rule=The device turns on if exactly one of object 0 or object 1 is placed, or object 4 is placed without any of object 0 or object 1.
Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 2, object 5, object 7]; rule=The device turns on when object 0 is placed on it along with an odd number of objects initially on the device.

Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1]; rule=The device turns on if either object 0 or object 1 is placed alone or with other objects, but turns off if both object 0 and object 1 are placed together.
